items.summary: About 200 people have been evacuated after a fire broke out at an industrial building in Hong Kong’s Tuen Mun when exterior scaffolding caught alight. Police said they were alerted to the blaze at No 2 Kin Fat Lane at about 2pm on Saturday.

items.summary: The Ontario Hockey League announced that a London Knights player and a Niagara IceDogs player have each been suspended following violations of the Canadian Hockey League Drug Education and Anti-Doping Policy.

items.title: Ontario wants feds to clarify what rights home invasion victims have to defend themselves
items.summary: Ontario’s attorney general and solicitor general are calling on the federal government to make changes to the Criminal Code to “strengthen and clarify the legal protections available to homeowners confronted with a home invasion.”

items.summary: Minister of Energy and Natural Resources Tim Hodgson was in Powell River on Friday, unveiling the government's first-ever Forest Sector Strategy.

items.title: Former B.C. minister George Heyman, ‘giant’ and ‘troublemaker,’ dies at 77
items.summary: Former British Columbia environment minister and longtime labour leader George Heyman is being remembered as a “giant” and “troublemaker” following his death at the age of 77.

items.title: Ontario court rules school boards cannot force councils to recite land acknowledgements
items.summary: The Ontario Superior Court has ruled that a school board cannot mandate its school councils – advisory bodies made up of parents, guardians, and caregivers – to include land acknowledgements at their meetings.

items.title: Pair receives probation, fines for dogs running loose in deer habitat
items.summary: Two Ontario residents have been fined and placed on two-year probation for allowing their dogs to run at large in white-tailed deer habitat during hunting season.
